degree_rationale: Treats the meaning/essence of 'Greatness' itself as title — what it is for various figures (Father of Greatness, the Ambassador, Jesus, Pillar) to be called by it. Reflective unpacking of an essence-term.
direction_rationale: North-turn at the celestial: the love/essence is now received and processed intellectually. The 'why is each one called Greatness?' question is reflective inner reception of what the south illumined.
grand_man_function: Celestial intellect — receiving what 'greatness' truly means within love.
title: On Greatness: what 'Greatness' truly is
